neighbours.label: ' in' (or ' location' / ' place') for being inside a non-physical place: time spent in a program, a meeting, the internet or a field
fire: Designers spend most of their working hours in Photoshop or Figma.
Write the ideas down on cards while you are still in the workshop.
Teenagers now pass several hours a day in online games.
She has spent thirty years in physics teaching without seeing such a result.
The proxy makes the request seem to come from a different location.
Accountants live most of the day in spreadsheets and email.
He spent his whole career in software testing and support.
Stay signed in and come back to see whether your name was drawn.
quiet: Designers spend most of their working hours near the big windows.
Write the ideas down on cards before the workshop begins.
Teenagers now pass several hours a day at the skate park in Leeds.
She has lived thirty years in Vienna without seeing such a winter.
The courier makes the delivery from a warehouse in Rotterdam.
Accountants sit most of the day in the office on King Street.
He spent his whole childhood in a village near Krakow.
The statue was moved to a square in the old town of Tallinn.

notes: Card: ' в' (интернете), 'in the meeting', 'time in Outlook', 'a lifetime in chemistry education', 'a different location' (for an IP address); the + pole takes geographic places, so the card suggests virtual vs physical location. Probes did not confirm it: such sentences scored 0.05-0.21, one 'different location' sentence 0.48 and another 0.03. Registered as the card's best reading; I expect it to fail.
